CustomField.description: Older storage for the icon or image on each visual picker card, read only while Picklist Option Settings is empty. Forms saved before Picklist Option Settings existed keep their icons here; the Customize Visual Picker window now saves icons and images to Picklist Option Settings instead. Stored as JSON mapping each API value to {type, icon} or {type, asset}. Options without an entry show a default icon.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Older visual picker icons and images, used only until the field's option settings are saved from Form Builder.
CustomField.label: Picklist Visual Picker Options
